source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 31 May 1961, p. 20 ("Notice of result of elections: Hillsborough Rural District")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the returning officer’s notice of result in the Belfast Telegraph of 31 May 1961.

note: Triennial election of Hillsborough Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Sixteen candidates were returned unopposed for sixteen seats. Addresses and occupations printed with the names are not reproduced (privacy rule; gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
